name: stem-lance-and-reductions
about: v0.202.0 bundle 4: 26RSD06-013 Stem Lance (Flash Magic: destroys an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit; when choosing the target you may destroy one of your Nexuses and the target cost limit grows by its cost), 26RBS03-022 Pisketona (its summon reduction is fulfilled one symbol per core in the opposing Reserve while every card in your Trash is Purple; When Attacks sends a core from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve and draws when it holds three or more) and 26RBS02-X15 Ganothor (all its reduction symbols are fulfilled when a Yellow Magic card was used this turn; its LV2 returns a Topaz Magic card from the Trash on an opposing Life hit).
